what: The plan assumes one-key-per-line parsing for relevant-checks output, but the helper emits several multi-KV lines
scenario_or_breakage: With a normal key-value parser, RELEVANT_CHECKS_OK becomes "true SITE=..." and STATUS becomes "fail FAILURE_REASON=...", so the loop can miss both pass and structural-fail states and fail to emit the intended final envelope
suggested_fix: Either change run-relevant-checks-captured.sh to emit one key per line via emit_kv for all statuses, or require a token-aware parser in review-and-fix.sh and pin success, skip, and structural-failure tests

what: The substantiality diff lacks a reliable per-round pre-coder baseline
scenario_or_breakage: Later rounds may diff from the round-1 pre-review HEAD or from a missing file, causing structural LOC to include prior rounds or collapse to zero, which silently changes loop continuation and cap-hit behavior
suggested_fix: Write round-N/pre-coder-head.txt immediately before apply_findings_with_coder for every round and diff exactly that SHA against round-N/post-coder-head.txt; add a round-2 regression where round 1 is large and round 2 is small

what: Loop mode omits a clear base ROUND_CAP handoff to review-and-fix.sh
scenario_or_breakage: The planned loop computes effective_round_cap from ROUND_CAP, but run-step5-review loop dispatch only forwards --mode loop and --starting-round; an empty cap can become arithmetic failure, cap 0, or divergent defaults between the banner and wrapper
suggested_fix: In loop mode set and pass --round-cap 5 as the base cap, or make review-and-fix.sh default and validate ROUND_CAP=5 for --mode loop; test loop default dispatch includes the cap

what: Extracting _implement_round_body without auditing existing exits can bypass the final STEP5 envelope
scenario_or_breakage: Security classifier failure, OOS mirror failure, or important-finding scan failure can still call exit 2 from inside the body or helper, leaving SKILL.md with no STEP5_REVIEW_STATUS to route and potentially hiding the failed security/skipped-finding path
suggested_fix: Convert body-reachable exits to returns plus captured status, or explicitly wrap and normalize every nonzero body exit into STEP5_REVIEW_STATUS=stall before process exit; add a classifier-failure test

what: The lint-fix retry path has no attempt cap
scenario_or_breakage: If checks keep failing while lint-fix-loop keeps returning applied, the new foreground wrapper can dispatch external coders and create commits indefinitely without reaching a final envelope
suggested_fix: Add a per-round lint-fix attempt cap, emit STALL_REASON=lint-fix-attempt-cap, and test repeated applied-plus-failing-checks behavior

what: The plan treats submodule-violation as a round status, but the current script emits it as CODER_STATUS under REVIEW_AND_FIX_STATUS=coder-failed
scenario_or_breakage: A submodule guard hit can be collapsed to STALL_REASON=coder-failed, losing the promised distinct stall token and making downstream issue routing/auditing less precise
suggested_fix: In run_implement_loop, map CODER_STATUS=submodule-violation to STALL_REASON=submodule-violation before the generic coder-failed branch, and pin it in the stall test
